reviews.text: Debra has been a long term friend of mine. She’s amazing at her job and loves all her fur babies. She just recently helped me rehome my fur baby. She’s now in a great home and very loved. If you ever need a great fur baby sitter or help she’s your girl.
Thank you!!!

South Loop Pet Care saved the day with a last-minute dog-sitting request. Debra & Angel were responsive and easy to work with. Angel provided pictures and updates multiple times a day while we were away. Most importantly our dog Yogi loves him!
Debra and Angel do a great job walking or Cali and Parker. Our PO gets love them. We love that they are always timely and reliable. They always send photos of our pups enjoying their walk!
Can’t say enough good things about South Loop Pet Care. I always knew when the dogs were walked and the pictures we got were great. Highly recommend!!!

Angel is the best!! Our dogs absolutely love him!! :)
Debra and Angel are great with communication and flexibility! I highly recommend!!
Awesome walker who consistently takes care of my big lab. Fun picture updates every walk is a very thoughtful gesture.
South Loop Pet Care has been walking our pup Mango for about 1 month and we very pleased with their work! We appreciate the love updates as walls occur.
The dog walking has been great, would highly recommend!
It’s a real life saver having a dog walker I can trust.  I like receiving pics and updates every time my pup is taken for a walk while I’m at work.

Debra was amazing! She let me know every time she was entering my condo and sent the cutest pictures of my fur baby daily for the whole two weeks that I was away. She even dressed my baby up for the holidays ❤️💚
We loved using South loop Petcare. Angel stayed with our two dogs, one aging and ill and did an exceptional job. He communicated with us daily, sent photos, and was amazing.

They were wonderful and did a great job taking care of my babies! They did an in-home meet and greet prior to the cat sitting and made sure they had detailed information and instructions about taking care of them and any emergency information. While they took care of them they sent me pictures daily if them, the food, water, and litter boxes which I HIGHLY appreciated. I will DEFINITELY be using them again!
Absolutely excellent experience with this service. 100% will use again.
Gave updates every day with pictures, took great care of my cats

Debra and Angel are fantastic. Angel took super great care of my little cat and sent me adorable updates each day. I feel like she’s very much in safe hands with the team and am glad to have such reliable pet sitters in the neighborhood.

I can’t say enough good things about South Loop Pet Care.  From day one, I have trusted the owner, Debra Fletcher, and our dog walker, Angel, since 2023. I met Debra while walking my newly adopted baby in our neighborhood. We were just chatting about the joys of puppies and she introduced me to her company.  I have been using their dog walking and pet sitting services since 2023. I’ve been impressed by the professionalism, organization, flexibility, and competitive pricing.  I receive images from Tristan on his walks and I can see how happy he is.  They treat my baby like family and he is always so excited when he sees Angel walk through the door.  He absolutely loves them and always comes home happy and well cared for.

The team is reliable, warm, and professional, and I’ve never had to worry about scheduling or communication. Their prices are competitive, especially considering the quality of service and trust they provide. It’s rare to find a company that combines professionalism with such genuine care and love for animals, but South Loop Pet Care does exactly that.

I highly recommend them to anyone looking for dependable and loving care for their dog!

SLPC has brought me so much peace of mind ever since we started using them for weekly dog walks & for in-home pet care for our 2 pitties 🐶🐕 when we are out of town. My dogs love Angel & look forward to his visits. And I love that they have something to do during the day when I'm at work! I also love that Angel sends me pictures from their walks.

Deborah has watched my cat on several occasions and she is truly a professional and animal lover! She does a great job spending time with my cat every visit, making sure he is fed and his litter is cleaned up, and that he receives playtime and attention. She is responsive and reliable. I also love the pictures from her visits to put me as ease that my cat is doing well.

I simply love working with South Loop Pet Care. They are always professional, highly communicative and extremely reliable. I always get adorable photos of my pet out on her walks. My fur baby is the best hands and I’m so grateful to get to work with such caring, kind people who love my pup as much as I do!!
Great and fast service

Deborah and Angel were amazing! Super accommodating and wonderful with our dog Pebbles. They have good dog vibes so Pebbles immediately warmed up to them.  They even accommodated a last minute add-on to watch the following day.  I highly recommend South Loop Pet Care!!

South Loop Pet Care are trustworthy, professional, and provide a great service. My wife and I both work in sectors that sometimes require us to leave town for up to two days on short notice, but South Loop Pet Care has never had a problem fitting our cats into the schedule. Since moving to the South Loop roughly two years ago, we have grown to trust them with our pet sitting needs.

South Loop Pet Care is the best and has been an absolute lifesaver for me and my pup! From daily walks to extended boarding, I always know my dog is in loving, capable hands. Debra and Angel are truly the best—reliable, communicative, and so kind. My dog absolutely adores them and gets so excited for her walks!

I really appreciate the updates and photos—it gives me such peace of mind knowing she’s getting exercise, attention, and care from people I completely trust. If you’re looking for a reliable, professional, and genuinely caring pet care team in the South Loop, look no further.
Deb and Angel do an excellent job taking care of my dog. They are everywhere in the neighborhood walking dogs and they know what works best for individual dogs. Highly recommend!

Been a client off and on for near two decades, and several successive doggies. Deborah (and most recently) Angel always deliver great service, are obvious dog lovers, and, like others, I find South Loop indispensable while traveling. Reliable (like clockwork); they walk my dogs seven days a week (1X daily, except when we’re out of town); and all my dogs have loved their walkers over the years. They also know the neighborhood well, since business is located in the South Loop. Highest recommendation.
Deb and Angel are always there for Tess. And Tess loves them.  As did my previous dog. Deb has been walking dogs for me for  12 years. And Angel is a great addition to SLPC.

Working with angel has been great! He’s very communicative with updates and questions I have while he’s watching Mia. He is also thorough with updates and following instructions i leave out for Mia while
I’m gone.

We started working with Debra and Angel a few months ago and they’ve been fantastic. Very responsive after our initial outreach, and our Boston Terrier loves when they come by for walks. All in all great animal lovers and wonderful to work with!

I hadn’t been away from my cats overnight yet so I was a bit nervous about leaving them. I didn’t need to worry at all! Nox and Fleamont received top notch care in my absence. They were well fed and watered and showered with attention. I got lots of progress pics and updates, which were deeply appreciated. I would definitely recommend South Loop Pet Care to anyone looking for efficient and affordable in-home pet care with a personal touch!
Debra and her staff do such a great job!  I highly recommend them.

I was somewhat frustrated with my experience at South Loop Pet Care. The website was misleading—it advertised $22 a day, but I was later charged $22 per visit, which doubled the cost I was expecting for two daily visits. On top of that, I didn’t receive daily updates as promised. I think I received updates about half the time I was away.
When I did get photos, most of them were of the litter box and food bowls—not of my cats. I would recommend more transparency and better communication.

Another satisfied experience with South Loop Pet Care.  Excellent care! Very knowledgeable and dependable. Kept us well informed while we were gone. Our dog loves Debra and South Loop Pet Care and so do we!
Debra and Angel took great care of our two kitties while we were away for a short weekend vacation. Will definitely book again :)
Debra and Angel are top notch and take amazing care of our picky shepherd mix. We’ve used them from short walks to in-home stays and cannot recommend them enough!

We absolutely love South Loop Pet Care! Angel is fantastic—always on time, reliable, and great with our pup. We really appreciate the adorable photos and updates during walks, which give us peace of mind while we're away. Scheduling is a breeze, and we've never had any issues. The team is professional, friendly, and truly cares about the dogs they walk. Highly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy and caring dog walking service!

We love SLPC! Debra and Angel are amazing. They are wonderful and take amazing care of my Brutus. Angel always sends the cutest pictures from their walks. Their communication is great, and they super dependable. So glad we found them!

Debra walks my yellow lab, Flannery, and takes exceptional care of her! She is responsive, communicative, sends multiple pictures each day, and truly cares about every dog she cares for. Flann pulls like crazy to say hi to her when we run into her in the neighborhood. We can’t recommend her enough!
We’ve been using Debra and Angel for several years now, and they take great care of the pups. I also greatly appreciate their flexibility as my schedule changes often. The pups love them.
I’ve been using Deborah and her team for a couple of years and have been delighted with their service. South Loop Pet Care is reliable and affordable and the sitters obviously love their pet clients.

Deb Fletcher and South Loop Pet Care provide exceptional, caring, and personalized service.  She and her colleague are both dependable and flexible.  I completely trust in my dog's well-being whenever he is in her hands.  Love that she takes photos AND is available whenever I need her, even if it is not very often and at short notice.

I highly and enthusiastically recommend South Loop Pet Care. If my Labrador could talk, she would too. I use them for all her walks and for whenever I need sitting for her. Their service is always top notch.
Debra and Angel are the best! We can always count on them to take great care of our boys. They are communicative and responsive and our boys love them!

As soon as I moved to the South Loop finding a trustworthy and reliable dog walker was one of my top priorities. I am SO happy I found Deb and Angel at South Loop Pet Care! They were super responsive, scheduled a meeting with myself and my dog, Stella right away. She loved them instantly! Stella gets daily walks, either by herself or with some other puppy friends in the neighborhood. I love getting the photos of her on her walks because she looks so happy! I have been working from home a few days when Angel comes and Stella is beyond excited to get out there with him. The team is really responsive and also keeps me up to date with anything going on that would be of concern for dog owners in the area. I would highly recommend South Loop Pet Care for anyone in the area looking for amazing care for your pets!

Debra and Angel take such amazing care of our pup. Angel is also a great photographer and captures these fun photos that always make my day. We’ve tried several other services in the neighborhood, and nothing compares to South Loop Pet Care!
Debra and Angel are great, they’ve been helping us out for nearly 5 years! Super reliable, always happy to help out. Couldn’t recommend more highly!

We (two cats, husband, and I) love Debra & SLPC. Our cats are always relaxed and happy when we return from a trip, and we enjoy seeing the fun photos she sends each visit. Debra is super reliable and responsive, too. We are so fortunate and grateful that she has taken such excellent care of our two cat boys for eight years. Knowing our cats are happy and well cared for makes travel much easier. Debra and SLPC are the very best.

We cannot enough great things about trusting our two big dogs with South Loop Pet Care! Deborah and Angel are AMAZING! Our dogs love them. They are great at communicating, and send the sweetest pictures and updates after every walk. Angel stayed at our place for a long holiday weekend as well before when we were out of town and it was so nice to not have to worry about anything while we were gone. We use them once to twice a day recently, and they are so responsive and easy to get ahold of! We couldn’t do these last few months without them! Very reasonably priced as well, could not be happier with their services and neither could our pups! Thank you!!

South Loop Pet Care has been walking our dog for a couple months. Debra and Angel communicate with texts and pictures to update us during the day. They are dependable and flexible. We are very happy with their services and highly recommend!
Love SLPC! My dog is always tired and happy after her walks! They are flexible and I trust my dog with them.

The south loop Pet Car personified incredible care and professionalism. I had an emergency situation where I had to leave town for 4 days. Within an hour of contacting the team, we had forms filled for my cat and home visits scheduled. Photos of my cat eating, getting pets and having his litter box cleaned were sent everyday. I couldn’t be more grateful for their service!

Debra is the BEST - communicative, reliable and reasonably priced. I always use her for in-home cat visits when I travel and I know that my cat will be as relaxed and happy as possible while I’m gone. Love all the visit pics I get, too! Best cat sitter I’ve had since living in Chicago hands down.

Debra and her team at South Loop Pet Care are absolutely incredible. Since Nacho was just a puppy, they've been there for us whenever we needed assistance. Their service is not only reliable and trustworthy but also incredibly sweet, convenient, and affordable. It's no wonder they pet sit for almost all the pets in our building in the south loop!

Recently, I found myself in a tough spot when my pet sitting plans fell through. But South Loop Pet Care came to the rescue in a matter of hours, ensuring Nacho was well taken care of. Their ability to follow instructions perfectly and provide constant updates with adorable pictures along the way truly sets them apart.

Being away from your pets can be challenging, but seeing how happy Nacho is to be with them always puts my mind at ease. He eagerly runs towards them whenever we spot them out with other dogs. I couldn't recommend South Loop Pet Care more! Their dedication and care make all the difference.
Very professional and knowledgeable when discussing my dog’s needs.  The walker’s love and patience for dogs is obvious, which gives me peace of mind.

I'm thrilled to share my exceptional experience with South Loop Pet Care! As a loyal customer for over 5 years, I've consistently received top-notch service. The owner is incredibly responsive, attentive, and always goes above and beyond to …
Debra is awesome highly flexible with your schedule and you can tell she truly cares about the dogs. I really appreciate her services . She also captures the best pics of my doggy
Compassionate and super reliable!
